correctness.rationale: The complete proof bounds t+2e by n-1 from distinct one-weight descendants, bounds the number t of adjacent-one source words by ceil((n-1)/2) using their weight-two output collisions, and attains the resulting floor((3n-2)/4) with explicit odd adjacent starts and mod-four nonadjacent starts. Every boundary n>=2 is covered. Exhaustive direct deletion generation n=2..84 and exact compatibility-graph independence n=2..11 supply independent computational checks, not the infinite proof.
